question: Where will you find the ‘Forbidden City’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Forbidden City** is located in China
 
• It is a **historic palace complex in Beijing, China**, which served as the imperial palace for Chinese emperors for almost 500 years during the Ming and Qing dynasties.
 
• It was the** imperial palace for 24 emperors** of the Ming and Qing dynasties,
 
 
• serving as the political and ceremonial centre of the Chinese government from 1420 to 1912.
 
 
 
• The **palace is a masterpiece of traditional Chinese architecture.**
 
• It is **known for its symmetrical layout, golden roofs, red walls, and intricate decorations**
 
• It is one of the best-preserved ancient palaces in the world and was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.
 
• It now functions as the **Palace Museum**, where visitors can explore the vast collection of artefacts from China's imperial history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• China 
 
 
• **China**, officially known as the **People's Republic of China (PRC)**, is a vast and historically rich country located in East Asia.
 
• China is the third-largest country in the world by land area, covering about 9.6 million square kilometers.
 
• It features a diverse geography, including vast deserts like the **Gobi**, high mountains like the **Himalayas**, plateaus, plains, and coastal regions. The longest river in Asia, the **Yangtze River**, flows through China.
 
• China shares borders with 14 countries, including India, Russia, Mongolia, and Vietnam.
